segments.t: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.
Behold,
they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed.
segments.note: παραλυτικόν を「a man who was paralyzed, lying」と説明的に訳す

segments.t: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic,
“Son, cheer up!
Your sins are forgiven you.”
Behold,
some of the scribes said to themselves,
“This man blasphemes.”
Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said,
“Why do you think evil in your hearts?
For which is easier, to say,
‘Your sins are forgiven;’
or to say,
‘Get up, and walk’?
But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—”
(then he said to the paralytic),
“Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
He arose and departed to his house.
But when the multitudes saw it,
segments.note: Ἰδόντες（分詞）を「when … saw it」と節化

segments.t: they marveled and glorified God,
segments.note: WEB は「marveled」と訳す（ビザンティン本文 ἐθαύμασαν 系の訳出）。ギリシャ語本文は ἐφοβήθησαν（恐れた）

segments.t: who had given such authority to men.
As Jesus passed by from there,
segments.note: παράγων（分詞）を「As Jesus passed by」と節化

segments.t: he saw
a man called Matthew
sitting at the tax collection office.
He said to him, “Follow me.”
He got up and followed him.
As he sat in the house,
segments.note: αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου（属格絶対）を「As he sat in the house」と節化

segments.t: behold,
many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.
When the Pharisees saw it,
segments.note: ἰδόντες（分詞）を「When … saw it」と節化

segments.t: they said to his disciples,
“Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
When Jesus heard it,
segments.note: ἀκούσας（分詞）を節化

segments.t: he said to them,
segments.note: 「to them」は補い

segments.t: “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician,
but those who are sick do.
segments.note: 「do」は ἔχουσιν χρείαν（6,7番）の共有

segments.t: But you go and learn what this means:
segments.note: πορευθέντες（分詞）を「you go and」と組み替え

segments.t: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’
for I came not to call the righteous,
but sinners
to repentance.”
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い εἰς μετάνοιαν（悔い改めに）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying,
“Why do we and the Pharisees fast often,
but your disciples don’t fast?”
Jesus said to them,
“Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn
segments.note: οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ νυμφῶνος を「the friends of the bridegroom」と訳す

segments.t: as long as the bridegroom is with them?
But the days will come
when the bridegroom will be taken away from them,
and then they will fast.
No one
puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment;
for
the patch would tear away from the garment,
segments.note: τὸ πλήρωμα（当て布）を「the patch」と訳す

segments.t: and a worse hole is made.
Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins,
or else
the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined.
No,
they put new wine into fresh wineskins,
and both are preserved.”
While he told these things to them,
segments.note: Ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτοῖς（属格絶対）を「While he told these things to them」と節化

segments.t: behold,
a ruler came and worshiped him, saying,
“My daughter has just died,
but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”
Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.
Behold,
a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years
segments.note: αἱμορροοῦσα（長血を患う）を「who had a discharge of blood」と訳す

segments.t: came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
for she said within herself,
“If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”
But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said,
“Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.”
And the woman was made well from that hour.
When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,
segments.note: θορυβούμενον を「in noisy disorder」と訳す

segments.t: he said to them,
segments.note: 「to them」は補い

segments.t: “Make room,
because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.”
They were ridiculing him.
But when the crowd was sent out,
he entered in, took her by the hand,
and the girl arose.
The report of this went out into all that land.
As Jesus passed by from there,
segments.note: παράγοντι … τῷ Ἰησοῦ（与格）を「As Jesus passed by」と節化

segments.t: two blind men followed him, calling out and saying,
“Have mercy on us, son of David!”
When he had come into the house,
segments.note: ἐλθόντι（与格）を「When he had come into the house」と節化

segments.t: the blind men came to him.
Jesus said to them,
“Do you believe that I am able to do this?”
They told him, “Yes, Lord.”
Then he touched their eyes, saying,
“According to your faith be it done to you.”
Then their eyes were opened.
Jesus strictly commanded them, saying,
segments.note: ἐνεβριμήθη（厳しく命じた）を「strictly commanded」と訳す

segments.t: “See that no one knows about this.”
segments.note: 「about this」は補い

segments.t: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
As they went out,
segments.note: Αὐτῶν ἐξερχομένων（属格絶対）を「As they went out」と節化

segments.t: behold,
a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.
When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke.
segments.note: ἐκβληθέντος τοῦ δαιμονίου（属格絶対）を「When the demon was cast out」と節化

segments.t: The multitudes marveled, saying,
“Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
segments.note: 「Nothing like this」は οὐδέποτε … οὕτως の構文の訳

segments.t: But the Pharisees said,
“By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”
Jesus went about all the cities and the villages,
teaching in their synagogues
and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom,
and healing every disease and every sickness
among the people.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い ἐν τῷ λαῷ（人々の中で）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: But
when he saw the multitudes,
he was moved with compassion for them
because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.
Then he said to his disciples,
“The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.
Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest
will send out laborers into his harvest.”
